taskDescription: Complete the crossword using key terms from PA RN1 | Renal Pathology I: Glomerular Disease & Renal Failure.

words.clue: The structural and functional filtration unit of the kidney, present in approximately one million per organ.
The specialized network of fenestrated capillaries where blood filtration is initiated in each nephron.
Highly specialized epithelial cells with interdigitating foot processes forming the innermost filtration barrier layer.
The transmembrane protein component of the slit diaphragm connecting podocyte foot processes.
Type IV protein that is the major structural component of the glomerular basement membrane.
The proliferation of parietal epithelial cells forming a pathological structure in rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis.
The enzyme released by juxtaglomerular cells when they detect decreased renal perfusion pressure or low sodium.
The outer microscopic zone of the kidney containing all glomeruli and most tubular segments.
The inner zone of the kidney where loops of Henle and collecting ducts create the osmotic gradient.
The central scaffold of mesangial cells and matrix that supports glomerular capillary loops.
